title: New Zealand vs India Preview and 2-0 Prediction
text:
New Zealand vs India Preview and 2-0 Prediction | News | Football.com Ghana New Zealand vs India Preview and 2-0 Prediction 
 Match Preview · Football · International · Int. Friendly Games · New Zealand · India 
 14 Nov 2026 
 🔮 Prediction
 New Zealand won 2 of their last 10 matches, while India lost 6 of their last 10. New Zealand average 2.4 goals scored and 1.0 conceded, compared with India's 1.0 scored and 3.4 conceded. New Zealand to win, expected score 2-0. 
 The scoring gap
 New Zealand average 2.4 goals and concede 1.0, while India average 1.0 scored and concede 3.4. The hosts have the stronger numbers at both ends: they score more and let in fewer. India's concession average gives New Zealand a route to turn that advantage into a home win. New Zealand to win is the clearest outcome supported by those scoring and defensive averages.
 The 2-0 scoreline has a straightforward path: New Zealand's 2.4-goal average gives them a platform to score twice, while India's 1.0 scoring average meets a New Zealand defence conceding 1.0. That combination supports the visitors being held scoreless, even as India's 3.4 conceded average leaves the hosts room to score.
 A narrow route to two goals
 Exactly two goals requires New Zealand to find the net without an Indian reply. The same 2-0 route keeps the total under 2.5. India's scoring average and New Zealand's concession average point to a limited threat from the visitors, while India's defensive numbers give the hosts opportunities. The total stays at two if New Zealand convert without turning those chances into a larger haul.
